text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Nice! Spiritoso, agilmente! Now, let's cross the mountains, con brio!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To this beautiful melodia, an energico 
anima has been added!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Remarkable comprehension, my agnellino! 
Even though people often say my bacchetta 
becomes più difficile—far too complex—the 
more passionate I get.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mainly on the language side of things! Are 
you well-versed in music, Pisa-san?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, not nearly as much as you, Earth-san. 
But... watching you give it your all makes 
it easy to understand."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make it wonderful, so let's 
keep pushing it higher and higher!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us work even harder. So that we may 
cheer Universe-san up!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
SÃ¬! Let us complete a duo to heal all of 
creation! Come, next time, I shall join 
you!
